book.name: Matei
book.title: Malobhe gha Mbone ngita chighajhandikwe na Matei

content: Kujhighanikiwa kwa Yecho
Peniya uhuke gwa Chapanga ujhakunnongocha Yecho ade kunjenga ajhighanikilwe na Limbembela.
Ajhakuleka kulyegha pajhomolila machiko makome ncheche muhe na kilo, peniya ajhakubhona njala.
Bhahe, Limbembela lijhakuhika na kunnobholela, “Anda chakaka mwe ma mwana gwa Chapanga, longela maghanga agha ghabhehe mabumunda.”
Yecho ngajhangwila, “Ijhandikwe mu Majhandiko gha Chapanga, ‘Mundo nalama ndeka kwa mabumunda tugha, kwa lilobhe lililongelwa na Chapanga.’ ”
Peniya Limbembela ajhakuntola Yecho ade ku Yeluchalemo, ku muche gwa nyahinyahi gwa Chapanga, ajhakummeka ku lulegheleghe lwa Nyumba jha Chapanga,
ajhakunnobholela, “Anda mwenga mwana gwa Chapanga, kiponeya pahe, mana ijhandikwe mu Majhandiko gha Chapanga,

content.text: ‘Chapanga nalaghalikiya akatumiche bhake bha kunane kwa Chapanga,

content: Yecho ajhakunnobholela, “Ijhandikwe mu Majhandiko gha Chapanga, ‘Nkotoka kunyigha Bhambo, Chapanga gwino.’ ”
Ndi Limbembela lijhakuntola ade kululegheleghe lwa kitombe kitandamaho, ajhakunnangiya unahota gwoha gwa pannema na ukolo gwake.
Ajhakunnobholela, “Nanipela henge yoha anda undamile makilikite na kunnyinamila.”
Peniya, Yecho ajhakunnobholela, “Bhokela oko Limbembela ijhandikwe mu Majhandiko gha Chapanga. Namunyinamila Bhambo Chapanga gwino na kunhengela jwenio kanjika chake.”
Bhahe, Limbembela lijhakunneka Yecho, na akatumiche bha kunane kwa Chapanga bhajhakuhika, kunhengela.
Yecho itumbuu lihengo lyake ku Galilaya
Yecho pajhohina ngita Yohane atabhitwe mukipungo ajhakujhenda ku Galilaya.
Ajhakubhoka ku Nachalete, kujhenda ku Kapelenaumo, muche ghubhii mupele jha mbwane jha ku Genechalete, mupakane mwa kilambo cha Zabulone na Nafutale, ajhakutama kwenio.
Lende litendika lilobhe lela lilongilwa na Isaya, jwakibha nnondole jwa Chapanga litimile,

content.text: “Ku kilambo chuku Zabulone na ku kilambo chuku Nafutale,
kujhendelela mumbwane kwiye jha lukemba lwa ku Yolodane,
ku Galilaya, ku kilambo cha bhando bha ilambo henge!
bhaluwene lumule lukolongwa. Nabhabhehe bhubhatamita ku kilambo cha lubhendo

content: Kuhumii machiko gheniya Yecho akatumbwii kubhola atangicha, “Muuleke uhakaho gwino nhwalo unahota gwa kunane uheghalile!”
Yecho abhakema bhapyeya homba ncheche

Yecho pakibha atyangita mupele jha lilabha lya ku Galilaya, ajhakwabhona akalongo bhabhele bhapyeya homba, Simone jwakemwa Petile na Anduleya nnongo gwake bhakibha bhapyeya homba kwa lwaho mulilabha nhwalo bhakibha bhapyeya!
Bhahe, ajhakwalobholela, “Ungengame, na nenga nanimmola kwapyeya bhando kwa Bhambo ngita hele chimupyeya homba.”
Papalapala bhajhakuleka lwaho lwabhe na kunkengama.

Ajhakujhenda palonge pandina, ajhakwabhona akalongo bhange bhabhele. Yakobu na Yohane, yana ya Zebedayo. Bheniya bhakibha nkate jha mungalabha pamonga na tate gwabhe Zebedayo, bhakibha bhitengenecha lwaho lwabhe, bhahe, Yecho ajhakwakema.
Na bhene bhajhakuileka ngalabha pamonga na tate gwabhe, bhajhakunkengama.
Yecho ilamicha bhibhalwalwa

Yecho akibha ijhenda kila chehemo jha ku Galilaya, ajhakubhola munyumba jha kukonganikii Akayahude na kutangacha Malobhe gha Mbone gha Unahota gwa Chapanga. Ajhakulamicha ulwalo ghoghoha ghubhakibha nabho bhando.

Bhando bhubhatamita kilambo choha chuku Siliya pibhajhoha gheniya. Bhibhalwalwa bhoha na bhando bhubhabhii na ulwalo na bhando bhibhalaghita. Bhibhachikilwe na michuka, bhubhabhii na kihinduhindu na bhando bhubhalemile bhakapelikwe kwa jwenie, na bhoha bhajhakulama.
Bhando bhamahele bhajhakunkengama, kuhumii ku Galilaya, na Dekapoli mana jhake miche kome, na ku Yeluchalemo, na ku Yudeya na kwiye jha lukemba lwa ku Yolodane.
